description: This line plot illustrates the layer-wise relative change in performance metrics for different quantization configurations applied to the KV cache of Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct using SnapKV pruning, with a fixed KV cache budget of 1/64. The x-axis represents the model layers, grouped into five segments: “Layer1-4”, “Layer5-12”, “Layer13-20”, “Layer21-28”, and “Layer29-32”, and is plotted on a linear scale without numerical tick labels. The y-axis represents the “Relative Change” in performance, scaled linearly from -25% to +5%, with tick marks at every 5 percentage point interval. Four distinct lines represent different quantization schemes: a yellow line with circle markers for “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”, a red line with square markers for “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”, a light blue line with circle markers for “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”, and a dark blue line with square markers for “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”. A dashed gray line labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line starts near 0% and ends near 0%, showing a slight dip around Layer13-20. The red line begins near 0%, dips slightly below -5%, then rises back to near 0%. The light blue line begins near 0%, dips to approximately -15% around Layer13-20, then rises to near 0%. The dark blue line begins near -5%, plunges to approximately -25% around Layer13-20, then rises to approximately -5%.
